statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction (Z86.73, G45.9)
The service was billed under CPT 93271
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of transient cerebral ischemic events
The cardiac event monitoring study was ordered to guide anticoagulation management
The claim was denied with reason code CO-97
The documented clinical indication supports the medical necessity of the service
